summary: The change fails acceptance criterion 6: `run_cycle` in `src/home_swe_home/orchestrate.py:162` has an uncovered falsy branch (`evaluator or _default_evaluator(...)`) because every `run_cycle` test passes a truthy `evaluator`, so the `_default_evaluator` fallback path is never executed and branch coverage cannot reach 100%. The author dispute does not contradict this, since the cited tests call `_default_evaluator`/`_score_base` directly rather than the `run_cycle` branch point.

findings.evidence: src/home_swe_home/orchestrate.py:162 (`score = evaluator or _default_evaluator(candidate_dir, trials)`); tests/unit/test_orchestrate.py — all seven `run_cycle` tests pass a truthy `evaluator`
findings.message: The falsy branch of the `or` in `run_cycle` (evaluator is None, so `_default_evaluator` is used) is never executed. With `--cov-branch --cov-fail-under=100` this violates acceptance criterion 6. Add a `run_cycle` test that passes `evaluator=None` to cover the fallback path.

evidence_check.evidence: src/home_swe_home/orchestrate.py:162 (`score = evaluator or _default_evaluator(candidate_dir, trials)`); tests/unit/test_orchestrate.py — all seven `run_cycle` tests pass a truthy `evaluator`
